title: XRP market structure snapshot with provider scope and supply-definition controls

data_cutoff.xrp_insights_supply: 2026-11-01 on-chain reads; ETF dashboard refreshed today
data_cutoff.coinmarketcap: Dynamic page crawled 2026-11-02; exact observation timestamp not exposed
data_cutoff.coinbase_derivatives: Dynamic product page crawled 2026-11-02; exact market-data timestamp not exposed

spot.rule: Do not force the 24h changes to reconcile; providers use different observation times and market/index methodologies.

derivatives.reconciliation: TradRadar's 7-exchange aggregate is about 2.52 times Kodexius's 7-contract figure. The provider sets are not identical; do not average or interpret the difference as a sudden market move.
derivatives.positioning_note: Positive funding and a 78.2% long-account share indicate a long-skewed account count in TradRadar's covered venues, not 78.2% of notional exposure. Liquidations were predominantly long in that 24h window; this is a risk/positioning observation, not a price forecast.

coinbase_derivatives.limitation: Dynamic page; exact timestamp not exposed. Do not combine with third-party USD OI totals without contract-level normalization.

etfs.methodology: Six U.S. spot XRP ETFs plus BITW index fund. Holdings are sourced from issuer websites; flow and volume data have their own timestamps and coverage.
etfs.limitation: Do not infer that ETF-held XRP is immediately available for sale or that flows equal net market purchases without issuer creation/redemption mechanics.

observations.definition: circulating supply outside Ripple's non-escrow holdings
ledger total_coins minus escrow; XRP not locked or burned, including Ripple operational holdings

supply.explanation: The figures answer different questions. XRP Insights explicitly says market-data providers subtract Ripple non-escrow holdings, while its own ledger-based measure does not. Neither should be labelled tradable float.
supply.overlap_warning: XRP Insights warns its category rows are not strictly mutually exclusive: exchange-custodied XRP backing wrapped tokens can also appear in DeFi/wrapped categories. Do not sum exchange, DeFi, ETF, corporate and custody categories as if they were disjoint.

hypotheses.H1: Long-skewed derivatives positioning and positive funding could amplify a downside move if price weakens and liquidations accelerate.
hypotheses.H2: Institutional product access and ETF holdings may deepen market access without proving net new spot demand or reducing liquid float in a predictable way.
hypotheses.H3: A large provider OI discrepancy may be methodology/coverage rather than market movement; contract-level normalization is required before using OI as a feature.

approved_as_raw_observations: ETF issuer holdings and flow windows
blocked_until_reconciled: exchange balances treated as tradable float
ETF holdings treated as permanently locked
DeFi/wrapped and exchange balances summed as disjoint categories
account long/short ratio treated as notional exposure

forecast.reason: Provider coverage differs, timestamps are not fully synchronized, and no validated out-of-sample model output exists.
